Subject: Sudden p99 latency & errors after v4.1/q6 deploy — immediate help requested

Marcus —

We just completed the model upgrade you coordinated (v4.1 with q6 quant profile) at ~07:30 PT and within 15 minutes we saw p99 jump from ~420ms -> 1.2s and a 3.8% increase in 5xx / decode errors. Several of our highest-volume endpoints are timing out and downstream processors are stacking up. We’ve attached a short sampling of traces and our SLA impact workbook.

Can someone confirm whether this is a config mismatch on the qprofile or a runtime issue? We need either a rollback or a mitigation toggle immediately — at minimum a canary pause or routing back to the prior model. Our SRE is standing by for any directives.

I’m looping Mark (ops) on the threads for visibility. This is customer-impacting; our execs are asking for ETA.

— Elena
Director, AI Platform
Spectra AI

Subject: Re: Sudden p99 latency & errors after v4.1/q6 deploy — immediate help requested

Quick technical note and ask from infra: 

Findings (first-pass):
- The q6 kernels introduced in v4.1 have a different attention kernel path optimized for mid-length sequences; our runtime appears to select a GPU kernel variant that regresses on long sequences (>1024) due to a codegen edge-case in the int8 dequant path.
- Canary telemetry shows an increased number of kernel preemption events and a higher KV cache thrash rate on the affected host group.
- Not a data/ prompt-regression — quality deltas look within tolerance for short contexts, but long-context generation latency and decode stability are impacted.

Immediate remediation steps we recommend: 
1) Rollback v4.1 -> v4.0 (qprofile-v3) for all Spectra traffic (Priyom to execute).
2) Disable the new int8 kernel selection policy for long-context routes and add a temporary routing rule that pins sequences >1024 to qprofile-v3 until we ship a hotfix.
3) Run a focused test harness that reproduces the failure modes (we have a test deck provided by Spectra).

I’ve prepared a short XLS with p99 by shard and included the raw traces. After rollback we should validate p99 at the edge and db write latencies.

Attachment: spectra_latency_report_20280425.csv

— Lauren
Principal Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
